ROLLCODEX.module.title: RollCodex
ROLLCODEX.panel.title: World connection
ROLLCODEX.panel.appUrlHint: Keep the suggested value for local testing. In production, use your public RollCodex HTTPS address.
ROLLCODEX.panel.appUrlInvalid: Invalid address. Use HTTPS in production or http://localhost for local testing.
ROLLCODEX.panel.contextHint: Labels shown in RollCodex for this Foundry world. Sent with each capture.
ROLLCODEX.panel.autoSnapshotHint: Foundry attempts a capture when the world or tab closes and after a chat idle period. The 'End session' button remains the most reliable way.
ROLLCODEX.panel.pendingMessagesNone: No new messages since last capture.
ROLLCODEX.panel.idleCountdown: Auto capture in ~{minutes} min if chat stays quiet.
ROLLCODEX.panel.confirmationPlaceholder: Paste the confirmation here if Foundry does not pick it up automatically.
ROLLCODEX.panel.pendingPairing: Pending request: {connectionId}. Foundry polls the status API and will finalize automatically.
ROLLCODEX.panel.pendingPairingNoApi: Pending request: {connectionId}. The RollCodex status API is unavailable - use the 'Recover' button.
ROLLCODEX.dialog.endSessionBody: RollCodex will capture all messages since the last successful capture. Use this when the session is over.
ROLLCODEX.dialog.disconnectBody: The local connection will be removed from this Foundry world. You can recreate it from RollCodex.
ROLLCODEX.dialog.cancelPairingBody: The current pairing request will be dropped. You can start a new one afterwards.
ROLLCODEX.dialog.sessionStartBody: A previous session was not captured. RollCodex can send the pending {count} messages now.
ROLLCODEX.notify.gmOnly: Only a GM can connect this world to RollCodex.
ROLLCODEX.notify.statusApiUnavailable: RollCodex status API unavailable. The 'Recover' button remains as a fallback.
ROLLCODEX.notify.popupBlocked: Popup blocked. Allow popups and try again.
ROLLCODEX.notify.pairingOpened: RollCodex window opened. Foundry will detect validation via the RollCodex API.
ROLLCODEX.notify.disconnected: RollCodex connection removed from this world.
ROLLCODEX.notify.snapshotSent: Capture sent to RollCodex. Review the import in your registry.
ROLLCODEX.notify.snapshotBlocked: Capture transmitted. Browser blocked the response, verify the import in RollCodex.
ROLLCODEX.notify.endSessionSent: End of session sent to RollCodex ({count} messages).
ROLLCODEX.notify.endSessionBlocked: End of session transmitted. Verify the import in RollCodex.
ROLLCODEX.notify.endSessionEmpty: No new messages to capture since the last capture.
ROLLCODEX.notify.readyConfigure: RollCodex is ready. Configure the connection in module settings.
ROLLCODEX.chat.help: RollCodex commands: /rollcodex end (end session), /rollcodex send (send capture), /rollcodex open (open panel).
ROLLCODEX.settings.appUrlHint: Address of the RollCodex application to open when connecting this world.
ROLLCODEX.settings.autoEnabledHint: Attempts a capture when the world or Foundry tab closes.
ROLLCODEX.settings.idleMinutesHint: If no chat message is sent during this time, RollCodex triggers a capture. Set to 0 to disable.
ROLLCODEX.settings.menuHint: Link this Foundry world to a RollCodex registry.
